part.text:
{
  "output_quality": {"score": 3, "reason": "A complete, recognizable race scene with sky/sun/clouds, grandstand, tote board, track, grass and four horses with jockeys. Gradients add depth, but the horses are tiny and crude and the track is a large flat block, so it is competent rather than appealing."},
  "instruction_following": {"score": 3, "reason": "Valid standalone 1200x800 SVG with no external assets or scripts; four horses, tote board, flags and finish camera present. Flaw: horses do not visibly translate across the track toward the finish across frames, and flowing manes/tails are unconvincing."},
  "creativity": {"score": 3, "reason": "Inventive details include a racing tote board timer, a photo-finish beam camera, dust puffs behind hooves and a crowd-dot pattern. Beyond those touches, styling and layout are fairly conventional."},
  "animation_fidelity": {"score": 2, "reason": "Clouds drift, dust pops and the tote board flashes, but the core requirement fails visually: across the three frames spanning 2.6s the horses stay in essentially the same positions, leg-cycling/bobbing in place rather than genuinely translating down the track toward the finish."},
  "richness_detail": {"score": 3, "reason": "Sky and sun gradients, radial glow, linear dirt/screen gradients, crowd-dot and rail-post patterns, plus many layered shapes. Depth is limited by the large flat brown track panel and small, flat horse figures."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 3, "reason": "Elevated side angle is sound: grandstand/tote board left, finish camera right, sky/sun frame the top. Coherent colors, but the oversized flat track block and tiny crude horses leave the scene unbalanced and under-polished."},
  "summary": "A valid, self-contained race illustration with most required elements and several working animations, but the horses fail to visibly race across the track as required, and the drawing is crude in places."
}
